oe_byd.17 = { # 陆墙下的强攻
    type = country_event
    outcome = negative
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/government/siege_battle_illustration.dds"
    title = oe_byd.17.t
    desc = oe_byd.17.desc
    trigger = { tag = BYZ oe_byd_ev_17 = yes }
    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_cd_17 months = 18 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_n17 } } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_n17 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_byd_n17 add = 1 } }
    option = {
        name = oe_byd.17.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_byd.17.a.tt
        hidden_effect = { oe_byd_assault = { gen = no } }
        ai_chance = { base = 60 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_byd.17.b
        trigger = { country_exists = c:GEN }
        custom_tooltip = oe_byd.17.b.tt
        hidden_effect = { oe_byd_pay = { months = 1 } oe_byd_assault = { gen = yes } }
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
    }
}
